description.value:
In the 2040s, the Perseus was considered the peak of Militech's hand-cannon models, boasting an impressive elven-shot rapid-fire cylinder. Last year, Militech announced a new weapon inspired by the legacy of the Perseus, but would be in their own marketing director's words, "bigger, badder, and baddass-er." The Triple Threat, a tri-barreled, .555 caliber, scoped revolver is what some gunsmiths have labeled "an abomination" and "an ode to firearm design insanity." Nevertheless, this weapon is capable of rapidly swapping ammunition types, retains the Perseus' rapid-firing abilities, and when handled properly can tear targets apart.

Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 6/6/6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No • Slots: 1 • Attachments: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Pistol Autosear, Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. This weapon has three 6-round magazines, that can each be loaded with a different ammunition type, with the user choosing which to fire on every Attack. Each magazine must be reloaded separately. When using Autofire with this weapon, it expends 2 rounds from each magazine (6 Total), applying the effects of each fired Ammunition Type individually. Requires BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm to wield unless Mounted.

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Pistol Autosear, Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is 6/6/6; the sheet tracks 6.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
